ABSTRACT 
The embodiments disclosed herein relate to various medical 
device components , including components that can be incor 
porated into robotic and / or in vivo medical devices , and 
more specifically including end effectors that can be incor 
porated into such devices . Certain end effector embodiments 
include various vessel cautery devices that have rotational 
movement as well as cautery and cutting functions while 
maintaining a relatively compact structure . Other end effec 
tor embodiments include various end effector devices that 
have more than one end effector .

ABSTRACT 
The embodiments disclosed herein relate to various medical 
device components , including components that can be incor 
porated into robotic and / or in vivo medical devices , and 
more specifically including end effectors that can be incor 
porated into such devices . Certain end effector embodiments 
include various vessel cautery devices that have rotational 
movement as well as cautery and cutting functions while 
maintaining a relatively compact structure . Other end effec 
tor embodiments include various end effector devices that 
have more than one end effector .
